title: Best Review Management Software 2026: 13 Tools Compared

facts.fact: Review Management software billed monthly typically runs from Free to $799 per month in 2026, according to CostBench's page.
facts.quote: **Review Management software** billed monthly typically runs **Free** to **$799** per month in 2026.

facts.fact: CostBench reports that the average monthly price across 8 review management tools is $193 per month.
facts.quote: The average across 8 tools is **$193 per month**.

facts.fact: CostBench reports that 3 of the 13 review management tools it compares offer free tiers.
CostBench's comparison covers 13 review management software products.
facts.quote: Side-by-side comparison of 13 review management tools.

facts.fact: Judge.me's starting price is free per month, with a popular tier at $15 per month and an enterprise tier at $15 per month, and it offers a free tier.
GatherUp's starting price is $40 per month, its popular tier is $60 per month, and its enterprise tier is $99 per month, with no free tier.
Reputation.com's starting price is $80 per month, its popular tier is $115 per month, and its enterprise tier is $150 per month, with no free tier.
A second CostBench listing for Reputation.com (reviews page) shows the same pricing: $80 starting, $115 popular, and $150 enterprise per month, with no free tier.
Yotpo's starting price is $89 per month, its popular tier is $129 per month, and its enterprise tier is $169 per month, with no free tier.
Stamped.io's starting price is $199 per month, its popular tier is $249 per month, and its enterprise tier is $798 per month, with no free tier.
G2's starting price is free per month, with popular and enterprise tiers both at $299 per month, and it offers a free tier.
Trustpilot's starting price is free per month, with its popular tier at $559 per month and its enterprise tier at $799 per month, and it offers a free tier.
CostBench's FAQ names Birdeye, Podium, and Trustpilot as top review management tools.
facts.quote: Top options include Birdeye, Podium, Trustpilot.
